bio.text: The Division of Wright is an Australian electoral division in the state of Queensland. It is southwest of Brisbane on the border with New South Wales, stretching from outside of the Gold Coast in the east to outside of Toowoomba in the west. Its first and current MP has been Scott Buchholz of the Liberal Party since 2010.
